correctness.rationale: Explicit distance-two neighborhoods imply the complete three-case membership classification. All-set counting starts from the at-most-one-empty-column polynomial and removes exactly the three stated invalid families, with a sixfold double-count correction only for n=3. Minimality follows from removal tests and an n=4 two-by-two exception. An independent BFS-from-graph verifier exhaustively checked 87360 vertex subsets for n=3..8, with exact agreement. Mathematical proof covers every integer n≥3; finite checks do not supply the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The question is motivated by complete set-family enumeration for the 2022 locating-hop domination notion, and is mathematically identical to locating domination of matching-deleted K_{n,n}. The theorem gives the full generating function, a complete inclusion-minimal census, and a sharp transition at n=5 from a single minimal cardinality to two. These structural and count facts are not implied merely by an optimum scalar bound and provide an exact diagnostic/monitoring configuration profile on a natural infinite family.
